summary: The complete MCAST_DESTRY_ARMR path now matches the admitted 399-step monk case. The C cast announcement, damage roll, destroy_arm draws, armor erosion message, and resistance update stay in source order; the destroy_arm adapter forwards the planner’s silent message operation through erode_obj.

source.branch: When the caster reaches MCAST_DESTRY_ARMR and the hero lacks Antimagic, mcast_destroy_armor calls destroy_arm. If the consumed result is false, C says “Your skin itches.”; if true, C marks the monster as having understood the resistance. With Antimagic, it calls shieldeff, marks seen resistance, and emits “A field of force surrounds you!”. The JavaScript destroy_arm adapter forwards the same message/planning operation to erode_obj and stop_occupation; this keeps preflight output on the cloned state without changing the source random or mutation sequence.
dependencies: do_wear.c:destroy_arm (its boolean result is consumed; the complete existing implementation in js/do_wear.js is reused, with its message/planning operation now forwarded to erode_obj and stop_occupation)
